digest.component_or_area: review-bot container Bedrock credential access via instance IAM role
propositions: The review-bot container requires Bedrock API credentials to invoke Claude models; the existing instance role rebar-gerrit-instance-role grants only SSM and KMS permissions, not Bedrock.

IMDS is reachable from containers on the host instance (proven by opcert's working SSM fetch via instance profile), so credential delivery is IAM-only; hop-limit contingency applies only if AC1 measures IMDS unreachable from review-bot.

The Bedrock Converse API authorizes against bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream (not bedrock:Converse), verified by real instance-role calls that fail with AccessDenied when only Converse actions are granted.

The grant must scope to Claude models and cross-region inference profiles using wildcards on region but specificity on model family (anthropic.claude-*), proven by negative-control deny of non-Claude models under the scoped policy.

A single-owner contract (iam.tf:4-9) requires downstream IAM changes to attach scoped inline policies via separate files (iam_s2.tf, iam_s4a.tf pattern), not modify iam.tf, so this story adds iam_s7.tf and leaves iam.tf unchanged.
